messages:
sylvia: Heads-up — AcmeHW flagged a mismatch between marketplace entitlements and our internal SKU mapping for their on-prem appliance usage. they see 0 tokens billed but entitlement shows active plan. any ideas?
omar: which marketplace? Azure or GCP?
paul: Azure Marketplace. partner sent a screenshot of the usage payload. looks like subscription_id vs offer_id mismatch occasionally.
jake: can you paste a redacted sample payload here? might be a timezone/windowing issue at the marketplace aggregation side.
sylvia: pasted sample from partner below (redacted):
```json
{
  "partner": "acmehw",
  "offer": "acme-edge-1",
  "subscription_id": "sub_XXXXX",
  "usage": [{ "timestamp": "2026-03-18T23:00:00Z", "units": 0 }],
  "entitlement": { "plan_code": "edge-pro", "state": "active" }
}
```
leah: the 0 units in usage looks suspicious — could be an Azure usage-window rounding bug. we previously saw midnight aggregations drop small-metering events if consumption < 1 unit in hourly rollup.
omar: finance sees credits created for some of these subs. we do a reconciliation job that joins marketplace events -> entitlements -> invoice line items. if usage drops to 0 for a window, we still mark entitlement as used. mismatch could be on our join key.
jake: probable join-key candidates: subscription_id, offer, meter_dimension. partner screenshots show offer, but their usage exporter sometimes omits meter_dimension and relies on offer mapping.
paul: i asked AcmeHW to confirm the meter_dimension they send. they said "edge.sessions" but in a few payloads it was blank. they said their SI integration used a legacy exporter that leaves the field empty for offline devices.
sylvia: status: partner will backfill three days of raw payloads. action items?
jake: i can add a quick tolerant join in the recon job: fallback to offer+subscription_id when meter_dimension missing. will add a feature flag.
leah: also propose a small ETL pre-check that normalizes missing meter_dimension to "unknown" and emits a warning metric. this will catch patterns before downstream joins.
omar: finance asks for a one-off backfill script that re-runs invoice attribution for affected subscription_ids for last 7 days. i'll own the charge adjustments if needed.
paul: partner success will draft a partner note explaining the short-term reconciliation and ask them to update exporter.
sylvia: can we also add a quick webhook validation rule at ingestion that returns 4xx to the partner (with helpful message) when required fields missing? avoids silent drops.
jake: yes — i'll prototype a 422 response with payload field errors. example response:
```json
{ "error": "missing_meter_dimension", "detail": "meter_dimension is required for meterized offers; send \"unknown\" if not applicable." }
```
billing-bot: alert: azure-webhook 422 errors spiking for acmehw from 2026-03-18T22:50Z to 2026-03-18T23:10Z (47 events)
leah: +1 on prod metric. can we create a dashboard tile for "missing_meter_dimension" and an alert if >50 in 1h?
jake: agreed. i'll add flag and dashboard before EOD.
omar: timeline for backfill and invoice rerun? i can do the rerun tomorrow if i get the list of subscription_ids from the recon job.
paul: i'll collect the list after partner backfills and drop it in the ticket.
sylvia: summary: (1) partner backfills raw payloads (AcmeHW) (2) Jake adds tolerant join + 422 validation + flag (3) Leah adds normalization metric and dashboard tile (4) Omar runs invoice rerun for affected subs once list provided (5) Paul sends partner comms. owners noted. target: include fix & backfill by 2026-03-20.
paul: ack, i'll sync w partner and post updates here. :thumbsup:
sylvia: thanks everyone — please ping if you hit blockers.
